proposed_capability: P00 refreshes existing root agent governance, doctrine, glossary and ontology with explicit human-owned control, typed independent background activity, forbidden OS configuration, and physical user takeover without intent loss. P01 adds bounded cross-adapter harness inventory, fail-closed validation in CI, scoped skill and operator proof report; reuse existing effect_authority and screen_admit, no new input daemon.
player_save_control_impact: Provider-scoped public repository code, contracts, tests and docs only; no input sent to Sims; no local Windows, Bluetooth, Print Screen, Escape/U, save or game setting edits.
expected_outcome: An agent opening BetterInstincts sees mandatory P00 human-sovereignty rules and P01 codebase/effect map. Every registered effect surface has a classification and enforcement owner. The harness validates ontology-graph relationships, typed effect contract, tests and CI wiring; human game/UI control gates independently from passive read-only work. Unknown or OS settings changes denied. Physical runtime and unadopted adapters stay explicitly unproven.

rollback_path: Revert the scoped two-stage branch commits; preserve previous ontology blob, existing governance, operating rules, game saves, Windows services and user profile.
